defects.zone: entire asset fill and alpha channel
defects.what: Every pixel in the asset is semi-transparent (maximum alpha 203 out of 255, mean alpha 138, with zero fully opaque pixels), making the eyebrows appear as a washed-out translucent grey instead of the solid opaque black marker cutout (#1a1612 / #000000) in the reference.
The brow interiors are filled with semi-transparent diagonal hatching stripes rather than the solid, uniform black marker fill of ref_cutout_layers/006_Layer_7_copy.png.
